thread:
Samir Patel: Quick check — what should our client-facing guidance say when a route degrades to a lower tier? e.g., return 200 with warning vs 503?
Jess Huang: I'd prefer 200 + structured warning unless it's completely degraded. 503 should be for terminal failures.
Thomas Li: Agree on 200 + warning. For SDKs we can add a response.metadata.fail_mode: "degraded" and quota hint.
Maya Ortiz: Can we standardize the field name? `x-redwood-status` vs `response.metadata.fail_mode` is confusing.
Samir Patel: Proposal: keep internal fields under metadata but expose header `x-rw-failmode: degraded;quota=LOW` for non-verbose clients.
Jess Huang: +1. That header is lightweight for infra. For console badges we map to three tiers: healthy / degraded / offline.
infra-bot: Deploy succeeded to staging (canary=10%) — service: routing-v2, sha: abc123
Thomas Li: telemetry note — we need a sampling key for degraded responses so dashboards don't get swamped. Suggest we tag events with `fail_tier` and sample 1% for healthy, 10% for degraded, 100% for offline.
Maya Ortiz: For sampling we should keep per-tenant override so customers can opt-in to full traces. Add tenant_id to sampling key.
Jess Huang: UX copy for console: "Degraded: responses may be served by lower-capacity model or cached outputs; latency may vary." Any objections?
Samir Patel: Wording looks fine. Also add a rollout note: when toggling fallback policy we should surface a transient banner: "You're on fallback routing — performance and cost may change" with link to docs.
Thomas Li: Open question: how do we map to HTTP statuses for client retries? I think 4xx for client errors, 503 for service unavailable (retryable), and 200+fail header for graceful degrade (not retry). Add a retry_hint header for SDKs.
Jess Huang: Example header set:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-rw-failmode: degraded;quota=LOW
x-rw-retry-hint: never
```
When it's 503 we include `x-rw-retry-hint: soon`.
Maya Ortiz: Can we add a console toggle to show only tenant-impacting degradations? It's noisy otherwise.
Samir Patel: Yes — add console filter `impact: tenant` and `impact: global`. Also include a small graph of degraded % vs baseline.
Jess Huang: I'll draft a tiny RFC for header names, sampling rules, and console copy. Tags: @Thomas @Maya for review. :thumbsup:
Thomas Li: Ack — will review tonight.
Maya Ortiz: Thanks, landing page copy review incoming tomorrow.
Samir Patel: Cool. If no blockers by EOD we'll roll canary to 25% and watch sampled telemetry.
